actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: seed

facts.text: The observation space is a Dict with the keys observation, achieved_goal and desired_goal
With learn_jerk and learn_mover_c_rotation false, the observation array is num_movers*4 values: the (x,y) position and (x,y) velocity of each mover
When learn_pose is false, achieved_goal is the object's (x,y) position (2 values) and desired_goal the desired (x,y) position (2 values)
The action space is a Box of num_movers*2 values bounded by -a_max_xy and a_max_xy
max_position_err defaults to 0.05 m and is the position threshold for goal achievement
The per-step penalty is -0.01, the collision penalty -10.0 and the at-goal reward 1.0
compute_reward applies the per-step penalty, replaces it with the collision penalty on a collision, and with the at-goal reward when the goal is reached without a collision
The episode terminates on a mover collision or a wall collision (or early termination when configured)
The environment's compute_truncated always returns False: the time limit is the Gymnasium TimeLimit wrapper
The default layout is a 4x3 grid of tiles when layout_tiles is None
The default number of control cycles applied per step is 40
The default MuJoCo option sets timestep=0.001 s
The environment takes cycle_time from model.opt.timestep
reset(seed) seeds the gymnasium RNG and rng_noise, and passes options to _reset_callback
The reset options mover_xy_start_pos, object_xy_start_pos and object_xy_goal_pos override the sampled positions

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the initial positions drawn by the environment and the dynamics are deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream environment also draws observation noise from the seed, while this package's fake is noise-free, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: rigid-body magnetic-levitation and contact physics of MuJoCo: no contact solver, friction, impedance controller, sensor or observation-noise model; the fake uses a kinematic stand-in
no rendering, no MuJoCo viewer and no 2D matplotlib view
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms (40 control cycles of 0.001 s) only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
the fake backend was not compared with the upstream environment (the gate does not import the clone): trajectories can differ from upstream's numpy random stream and MuJoCo state
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
